name: rent2own
description: Rent-to-own agreements you can check with a pencil: price, rent, credit share and term in; a month-by-month schedule out (equity built, strike price at exercise, balance left to finance). Saved deals and payment logs live in one local JSON file. Stdlib only, nothing calls out.

endpoints./info: Null call - what this module is and what it exposes
endpoints./health: Liveness plus agreement count (local disk only)
endpoints./quote: Deal at exercise + schedule (price=, rent=, credit=, months=, option_fee=, appreciation=, full=)
endpoints./agreement: One agreement with its schedule marked up to months paid (id=)

notes.local_first: all math is stdlib; agreements live in ~/.mod/rent2own/agreements.json (override with RENT2OWN_DATA) - no external calls
notes.content_addressed: an agreement id is a hash of its terms and parties - saving the same deal twice lands on the same id
notes.writes_not_exposed: save/pay/remove are CLI-only until the module gets an auth story; api_fns are read-only
notes.sibling: openhouse is the on-chain rent-to-own protocol; rent2own is the offline calculator and ledger
